unlisted_practices: Incorporate tumor location into AI-driven prognostic models for cancer.
Conduct sex-stratified analyses in prognostic model development and decision-making.
Standardize data input and processing pipelines across sites and EHR systems to minimize variability.
Embed validated AI models within EHR systems to support real-time clinical decision-making.
Collaborate with clinical guideline committees to evaluate the feasibility of AI-derived risk scores.
Ensure AI systems are interoperable with existing hospital IT infrastructure and data standards.
Protect patient privacy in accordance with applicable national laws.
Make AI models explainable using methods such as SHAP values to gain clinician trust.
Address data imbalance in rare tumor sites using ensemble learning and resampling techniques such as Balanced Random Forest and SMOTEENN.
Use federated learning for cross-institutional model development without sharing raw patient data.
Perform internal validation of AI models with k-fold cross-validation and bootstrapping, evaluating AUROC, sensitivity, specificity, and calibration plots.
